finding.expected: Bind REPAIR_AUTHORING to the complete existing Runtime FAILURE contract before projecting diagnostics, preferably by reusing validate_runtime_failure_binding() rather than maintaining a second partial validator. Preserve the closed minimum-safe diagnostic projection: structured verification/native/executor diagnostic payloads and raw logs must not leak into the packet. Add regression coverage proving Runtime-shaped VERIFICATION, EXECUTION and COMPLETION_GATE failures are representable, while missing or inconsistent kind/executor/base/candidate flags, changed-files/outside-scope bindings, or unrelated RUN/TASK/head identities fail closed. Canonical failures whose diagnostic message contains machine-local material must not force Brain to consume that material; project only safe bounded facts rather than passing raw diagnostic content through.
finding.issue: The correction now accepts a structured Runtime error mapping, but REPAIR_AUTHORING still does not validate the supplied FAILURE as the canonical Runtime FAILURE contract. It checks only run_id, failed_head_sha, task identity and changed_files. A malformed FAILURE that omits mandatory Runtime fields such as kind, executor, base_sha, candidate transportable/repairable/ dirty/descends_from_base/outside_task_scope can still compile when its error.type/message are well formed. This is a direct fail-open counterexample to AC2 and to FINDING-178-003's requirement that malformed failure material fail closed. The repository already has validate_runtime_failure_binding() for the exact Runtime FAILURE identity/candidate contract, but the correction does not reuse it.

original_constraints: AIOS_DECISION_PACKET v1 remains one deterministic, read-only, provider-neutral envelope for exactly one selected semantic decision and supports exactly the existing six BP-3 flows: ARCHITECTURE, TASK_AUTHORING, SEMANTIC_REVIEW, REMEDIATION_AUTHORING, REPAIR_AUTHORING and DIAGNOSTIC. NONE, unknown flows, unknown payload kinds and packet nesting fail closed.

Preserve Decision Packet v1 boundedness and portability: rendered packet at most 131072 UTF-8 bytes; Human input at most 16384 bytes; any included free-text excerpt/delta field at most 65536 bytes; invalid Unicode, NaN/non-JSON values and over-bound input/output fail closed without truncation. Exclude machine-local root/workspace/remote details, raw evidence paths/logs, secrets, chat history, chain-of-thought, timestamps and provider/session metadata.

Do not modify files outside scope.modify. If satisfying this contract requires changing Unified State, Correction Frontier, Flow Resolver, transport/publication contracts, correction dispatch/approval authority, provider surfaces or frozen Kernel semantics, fail closed back to Brain rather than widening scope.
